nights.title: The Living Tombstone - The Multiplayer Tour
nights.name: The Living Tombstone
nights.extract: The Living Tombstone (TLT) is an Israeli-American electronic rock group and YouTube channel, founded as a solo project by Israeli-American producer Yoav Landau in 2011, and becoming a musical duo with American singer Sam Haft in 2016. The group is notable for their songs based on video games and pop culture media, such as the My Little Pony, Five Nights at Freddy's, and Overwatch series as well as original music. Signed to Warner Music, they have released two studio albums, Zero One (2020) and Rust (2025).

facts: Die Gruppe ist bekannt für Songs zu Videospielen und Popkultur, etwa zu den Serien My Little Pony, Five Nights at Freddy's und Overwatch, sowie für eigene Musik.

nights.title: Eric Lindell
nights.name: Eric Lindell
nights.extract: Eric Lindell is an American singer-songwriter. His recording career began in 1996 as a regional Sonoma County-based artist. Since 2006, when he was picked up by Alligator Records, he has toured nationally and internationally. He recorded three albums for Alligator and has since issued several CDs on smaller indie labels.

Since 2006, when he was picked up by Alligator Records, he has toured nationally and internationally.

2006'dan beri, Alligator Records ile sözleşme imzaladığından beri ulusal ve uluslararası turneler yapıyor.

nights.title: Bowling For Soup
nights.name: Bowling for Soup
nights.extract: Bowling for Soup is an American rock band formed in Wichita Falls, Texas, in 1994. The band consists of Jaret Reddick, Gary Wiseman, and Rob Felicetti. The band is best known for its singles "Girl All the Bad Guys Want", "1985", "Almost", "Punk Rock 101", and "High School Never Ends". The band is also known for performing the theme song for the Disney Channel animated series Phineas and Ferb. Following lead guitarist Chris Burney's retirement in 2025, Reddick is the sole remaining original member.

nights.title: Pretty Lights - Soundship Space Bus Tour
nights.name: Pretty Lights
nights.extract: Derek Vincent Smith, known by his stage name Pretty Lights, is an American electronic music producer. Pretty Lights was originally a music project consisting of Smith and Michal Menert, who left after the release of their first album and returned in 2023. Rick Rubin once described Pretty Lights as "the face and voice of the new American electronic music scene".

nights.title: Jon B.
nights.name: Jon B.
nights.extract: Jonathan David Buck is an American R&B singer, songwriter and record producer. His debut album Bonafide (1995) spawned the hit singles "Pretty Girl" and "Someone to Love", the latter of which reached the top ten on the Billboard Hot 100 and was nominated at the Grammys Awards for Best Pop Collaboration with Vocals. His second album Cool Relax (1997), was certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). Cool Relax included the hit singles "Are U Still Down" and "They Don't Know". His third album, Pleasures U Like (2001) reached the top ten on the Billboard 200 chart.

en.who: Jonathan David Buck is an American R&B singer, songwriter and record producer. His third album, Pleasures U Like (2001), reached the top ten on the Billboard 200 chart.
facts: His debut album Bonafide (1995) spawned the hit singles "Pretty Girl" and "Someone to Love", the latter of which reached the top ten on the Billboard Hot 100 and was nominated at the Grammys Awards for Best Pop Collaboration with Vocals.

nights.title: Dinosaur Jr
nights.name: Dinosaur Jr.
nights.extract: Dinosaur Jr. is an American rock band formed in Amherst, Massachusetts, in 1984. The band was founded by J Mascis, Lou Barlow, and Murph (drums). After three albums on independent labels, the band earned a reputation as one of the formative influences on American alternative rock. Creative tension led to Mascis firing Barlow, who later formed Sebadoh and Folk Implosion. His replacement, Mike Johnson, came aboard for three major-label albums. Murph eventually quit, with Mascis taking over drums on the band's albums before the group disbanded in 1997. The original lineup reformed in 2005, releasing six albums thereafter.

facts: After three albums on independent labels, the band earned a reputation as one of the formative influences on American alternative rock.
The original lineup reformed in 2005, releasing six albums thereafter.

de.who: Dinosaur Jr. ist eine amerikanische Rockband, die 1984 in Amherst, Massachusetts, gegründet wurde. Gründer sind J Mascis, Lou Barlow und Murph am Schlagzeug.
facts: Nach drei Alben bei Indie-Labels galt die Band als einer der prägenden Einflüsse des amerikanischen Alternative-Rock.
Die ursprüngliche Besetzung formierte sich 2005 neu und veröffentlichte danach sechs Alben.

tr.who: Dinosaur Jr., 1984 yılında Massachusetts'in Amherst kentinde kurulmuş Amerikalı bir rock grubudur. Grubu J Mascis, Lou Barlow ve davulcu Murph kurdu.
facts: Bağımsız plak şirketlerinden üç albümün ardından grup, Amerikan alternatif rock'ının biçimlendirici etkilerinden biri olarak ün kazandı.
Orijinal kadro 2005'te yeniden bir araya geldi ve ardından altı albüm yayımladı.

nights.title: David Nail: Down to the Studs
nights.name: David Nail
nights.extract: David Brent Nail is an American singer/songwriter and country music artist. In 2002, he debuted the single "Memphis" from an unreleased album for Mercury Records Nashville. Five years later, he signed with MCA Nashville, for which he has released four studio albums: I'm About to Come Alive, The Sound of a Million Dreams, I'm a Fire, and Fighter plus two extended plays, 1979 and Uncovered. The albums have produced seven chart entries on Hot Country Songs and Country Airplay, including two that have reached No. 1: "Let It Rain" and "Whatever She's Got", plus the top 10 hit "Red Light".
